root_cause.text: seg6_input_core() and rpl_input() call ip6_route_input() which sets a NOREF (non-refcounted) dst on the skb, and then pass it directly to dst_cache_set_ip6() which unconditionally calls dst_hold() on the potentially stale or freed dst, allowing a concurrent FIB update (via shared nexthop) to free the underlying pcpu_rt and cause a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states: "seg6_input_core() and rpl_input() call ip6_route_input() which sets a NOREF dst on the skb, then pass it to dst_cache_set_ip6() invoking dst_hold() unconditionally." It then details a race sequence where a higher-priority task releases the pcpu_rt (dst) due to a serial number bump, leading to skb_dst pointing to a dead dst on which dst_hold() is called, resulting in a WARN/use-after-free. The patch fixes this by adding skb_dst_force() after ip6_route_input() to convert the NOREF dst into a refcounted one before caching.

intent_record.intent_summary: Force a reference count on the dst set by ip6_route_input to avoid use-after-free and add a null check to drop the packet on route failure.
intent_record.what: Added skb_dst_force(skb) after ip6_route_input(skb) to obtain a reference count on the dst, and added a NULL check for dst after that, setting err to -ENETUNREACH and dropping the packet if dst is NULL.
intent_record.how: Ensures the dst returned by ip6_route_input is properly refcounted before being cached or used further, preventing potential use-after-free, and handles the case where dst becomes NULL by dropping the packet with an appropriate error code.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix missing refcount and NULL check for dst from ip6_route_input in seg6_input_core.
intent_record.what: Added skb_dst_force() call after ip6_route_input() to acquire a reference on the dst, and added a NULL check on the dst pointer with a -ENETUNREACH error and goto drop.
intent_record.how: Prevents use of an unrefcounted dst and avoids NULL pointer dereference; drops the packet with ENETUNREACH if dst is NULL.

candidates.rationale: Obtains a NOREF (non-refcounted) dst from skb after ip6_route_input(). This dst may become stale due to concurrent FIB updates, and later uses (like passing to dst_cache_set_ip6()) without a refcount lead to use-after-free.
Dereferences the NOREF dst to check its fields, which is unsafe if the dst has been freed concurrently. This access occurs before any refcount increase and is part of the vulnerable flow.
